label: AMD EPYC 7402P (Zen 2, 24C/48T, 1 socket) — CloudLab c6525-100g
_note: max_mem_gb omitted: detected at sweep time (CPU MemTotal/sockets*0.8, GPU nvidia-smi*0.9). Placements resolving to the same CPU set and scaling counts >= the socket's cores are dropped automatically.

derivation.bandwidth: 8 channels x DDR4-3200 x 8 B = 204.8 GB/s (dmidecode: 8x16 GB DDR4-3200, DIMMs A1-A8, one per channel)
derivation.compute: 24 cores × 3.35 GHz (maximum boost; AMD publishes no all-core figure, so this is an upper bound) × 16 fp64 FLOP/cycle (2 × 256-bit FMA) = 1.29 TFLOP/s fp64; fp32 = 2×
